# VR Georgia

> Real-estate marketplace for Georgia (Sakartvelo): apartments, houses, land, commercial spaces, with VR/3D tours, map search and agent listings.

## Preferred languages
- Georgian (ka) — primary site language
- English (en) — UI + translated listing fields
- Russian (ru) — UI + translated listing fields

## Main pages
- Home / search: https://vrgeorgia.ge/
- Map search: https://vrgeorgia.ge/map
- Agents directory: https://vrgeorgia.ge/agents
- Architecture services: https://vrgeorgia.ge/services
- About: https://vrgeorgia.ge/about
- FAQ: https://vrgeorgia.ge/faq
- Sitemap: https://vrgeorgia.ge/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://vrgeorgia.ge/robots.txt

## What the product does
- Public search for sale, rent and mortgage listings across Georgia
- Filters: property type, price, area, rooms, city/district, land agricultural status, amenities
- Property detail pages with photos, optional 360/VR tours, price and contact
- Agent profiles with portfolio listings
- Structured data: Organization, WebSite, RealEstateListing, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, AboutPage

## Listings
- URL pattern: https://vrgeorgia.ge/property/{id}
- Fields typically include: title, description, price (USD/GEL), sqm, rooms, address, city, deal type, photos, tour links

## Agents
- Directory: https://vrgeorgia.ge/agents
- Profile: https://vrgeorgia.ge/agents/{id}

## FAQ topics covered on /faq
- What is VR Georgia
- How to find apartments/houses in Tbilisi
- What VR/3D tours are
- How to find agents
- Price currency (USD/GEL)
- Agricultural vs non-agricultural land
- Contacting listing owners

## Machine-readable API (public read)
- Properties list: https://vrgeorgia-api.onrender.com/api/properties
- Single property: https://vrgeorgia-api.onrender.com/api/properties/{id}
- Agents list: https://vrgeorgia-api.onrender.com/api/agents
- Optional query: `?lang=ka|en|ru` for translated title/city/street/description

## What not to index
- /admin, /login, /profile, /upload, /favorites, /compare, /messages (private / account areas)

## Contact
- Website: https://vrgeorgia.ge
- (Social profiles and public phone/email will be added when available)
